newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Preston shares surge on nickel find hopes.
newsitem.headline: Preston shares surge on nickel find hopes.

text.p: Shares in nickel hopeful Preston Resources NL rode higher on Thursday, the tightly held stock climbing nearly 18 percent to A$3.05 as traders took an upbeat view of the company's Marlborough lateritic nickel project in central Queensland.
"The last set of results confirmed their earlier drilling figures," said a Sydney-based resource analyst, adding that the company was looking attractive relative to other nickel plays.
"Preston is becoming an attractive alternative to some of the other nickel stocks in the market."

Preston's last set of drilling results, issued on July 17, from Coorumburra East produced best results of 15 metres at 1.43 percent nickel, five metres at 1.64 percent nickel and 17 metres at 1.22 percent nickel.
